changelog: Added/Fixed — Dashboard KPIs now follow the time window + new KPIs + chart i18n
New `/api/dashboard/kpis?from&to` aggregates KPIs from the rollups (full history, O(buckets)): counts (Attempts/Answered/ASR/NER/Failed) from the global `call_s
New KPIs: "Active now" (live in-progress calls), "Answered", and "Total calls" renamed to "Attempts".
Short calls fixed: now counts only answered calls under 10s, as a % of answered (possible false-answer) — no longer inflated to ~100%.
